551679.Description: This listing is not a physical item. Please keep in mind that this Code Card listing represents a digital copy of the stated item for the Dragon Ball Super Fusion World Digital Card Game. You may receive the physical Code Card. Upon purchase, please work with your specific Seller by sending them a message using the Contact Seller button on the order details in your Order History to opt in to having your Code Card code delivered digitally due to the nature of the product.

557034.Description: [Auto] [Once per turn] When you use a card in a combo while this card is in a battle, play up to 1 Battle Card with a cost of 2 or less and "Bardock's Crew" in its special traits from your hand.

557035.Description:
[Double Strike] (This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking.)

[Activate Battle] [Your Turn] [Once per turn] If you have 2 or more cards in your Combo Area, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and KO it.

557036.Description: [When Attacking] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 3 or less and "Saiyan" in its special traits and KO it. Then, if you have an energy marker, choose up to 1 [Field] in your opponent's Battle Area and place it in its owner's Drop.

557037.Description: [Activate Battle] Choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +15000 power for the battle. Then, if you have a card in your Combo Area, draw 1 card.

557038.Description:
